### Presuming upon God's Kindness
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/presuming-upon-gods-kindness-2
Passage: Ecclesiastes 8:10-11
Points:
- Inefficient justice systems and delayed consequences embolden wrongdoers to pursue evil with apparent impunity.
- Society frequently compounds this problem by honoring corrupt individuals who appear to escape accountability.
- Delayed judgment is not divine indifference, but rather God's merciful kindness intended to prompt repentance.
- Presuming upon God's patience hardens the human heart and only stores up more severe judgment in the end.
- Believers can rest assured that God's justice, though seemingly slow, will surely arrive at the right time.
